messages:
sam.dev: Quick Q — joining Redwood next month. Two parts: 1) How does the 401(k) employer match and vesting work? 2) I'm eligible for an HDHP — what's the process for enrolling in an HSA vs electing a health FSA? Also, any guidance on rolling over my old 401k (Fidelity) into Redwood's plan? Thanks!

ashley: Welcome, Sam! Short answers: we match 50% of your deferral up to 6% of eligible pay (so max company match = 3% of pay). Employer match vests 50% after 1 year and 100% after 2 years. Employee contributions vest immediately.

sam.dev: Thanks! Can I change from pre-tax to Roth 401(k) anytime?

ben-payroll: Yes — you can switch elections any pay period. To update: Workday > Pay > Change 401(k) elections OR submit a payroll change ticket. If you prefer, ping payroll@redwood.com and we'll process it. Note: Roth applies to new deferrals only (historical pre-tax deferrals require a conversion; check BrightPath portal for in-plan conversion options).

maria: For HSA: you must be enrolled in the company HDHP. Redwood contributes $500/year (pro-rated based on start date) to employee HSAs. HSA contributions go through payroll and roll over year-to-year. If you elect an HSA, we offer a limited-purpose FSA (dental/vision) option instead of a general health FSA. General health FSA is subject to the usual use-it-or-lose-it rules with a small IRS-allowed carryover — BrightPath will show the exact amount for the plan year.

sam.dev: Who is the 401(k) vendor and how do I initiate a rollover?

ashley: Vendor: BrightPath Retirement. Portal (internal shortcut): https://brightpath.example.com/redwood. For rollovers you can start from the BrightPath portal: Account > Rollovers > Start a Rollover. They accept trustee-to-trustee transfers from Fidelity/Vanguard/etc. If you want an official plan letter or plan ID for your old provider, email benefits@redwood.com and we'll attach the docs.

ben-payroll: Quick steps if you want them: ```1) Log into BrightPath portal 2) Account > Rollovers > 'Start a Rollover' 3) Choose 'Incoming' and enter old plan provider info 4) BrightPath emails transfer forms 5) Submit forms to your old provider or authorize trustee transfer``` If you'd rather we help, reply here or email payroll@redwood.com. BrightPath support: 1-800-555-0142 (Mon–Fri 9–6 ET).

benefits-bot: Reminder: Open enrollment runs Nov 1–15 each year. HDHP/HSA elections must be completed during Open Enrollment unless you have a qualifying life event.

sam.dev: :thumbsup: That helps. Last Q — does the plan support 401(k) loans or catch-up contributions (50+)?

ashley: BrightPath supports in-plan loans for eligible participants — loan availability and limits vary; contact BrightPath or benefits@redwood.com to confirm your eligibility. Catch-up contributions for participants 50+ are supported; enable in your BrightPath account or ask payroll to flag it for you. Also note IRS limits change yearly, so double-check the limits in the portal.

sam.dev: Thanks everyone — I'll set up my elections and DM if anything comes up.
